content.comment_body: Can anyone assist? I have a [product_name] [article_no] and connected an [product_name] analog input module with two pressure sensors (4-20mA output). The analog inputs are set as 3 and 4. I recently added a second [product_name] analog module and assigned input as 5, while not using the remaining input. Is this assignment correct? It appears I'm getting conflicts which affect readings on analog inputs 3 and 4.

Your setup appears correct. The [product_name] software allows you to configure two or four analog inputs depending on the main unit. The second module uses inputs I5 and I6. If I6 is unused, it should not create any issues. Please double-check your wiring—it should be in good order. Try initially with only two analog inputs (AI3 and AI4) and verify if they operate correctly.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is encountering unexpected issues when adding a second analog input module to a [product_name] controller system, observing disruptions in the readings of existing analog channels. Community feedback confirms the configuration is typical and supported by the software, but points to wiring or activation order as possible sources of error.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to add a second analog input module and assign new inputs without interfering with the functionality or accuracy of the original analog inputs.
